snippet.title: The Blood Moon Reckoning (Gameplay Teaser) - The Sky Village
snippet.description:
Welcome to another video. Today I am showcasing my game that I have been working on for the past 5 months. It's still incomplete but will be due to release sometime when summer hits. This video specifically shows off the Sky Village where you the player can find your weapons gear food, etc. from the npcs within the village. 

INTERESTED? check out the launch website!
https://tbmr.dreamcraftnetwork.com/
https://tbmr.dreamcraftnetwork.com/discord
